Device Name
APRO 70 Swift Catheter
Indications for Use (Describe)
The APRO 70 Swift Catheter is indicated for use in facilitating the insertion and guidance of appropriately sized
interventional devices into a selected blood vessel in the peripheral and neurovascular systems.
The APRO 70 Swift Catheter is also indicated for use as a conduit for retrieval devices.
